items.title: LPM playground
items.summary: Run business classification demos (email triage, support tickets, document sorting, sales leads, a sensitive-text check, and your own) with a small language model on your own GPU, in the browser. Nothing you type is sent anywhere.

items.title: Voice chat
items.summary: A fully on-device voice conversation in your browser: microphone to VAD to turn detection to ASR to a small LLM to Kokoro speech, with barge-in. Nothing is sent anywhere.

items.title: EcoSimulation
items.summary: Condition a stock-flow-consistent AI-economy model on a driver state and watch six macro and financial series re-fan across five years.

items.title: Brev tree traversal
items.summary: Watch a 400M encoder walk a 23-node intent tree on Banking77, node by node, replayed from a recorded run, compare it with flat rules and a 27B model, then time the same encoder on your own GPU in the browser.
